summary: Crescent Biopharma, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an underwritten public offering of 8,094,793 ordinary shares at $14.50/share and 525,897 pre-funded warrants at $14.499/warrant, with a 30-day underwriter option for up to 1,293,103 additional shares. Jefferies and TD Securities acted as underwriters. The offering is a standard primary equity financing, not a special situation. Net proceeds are ~$115.9M ($133.5M if option exercised). Closing expected July 16, 2026, subject to customary conditions. No special-situation attributes—ordinary capital raise.
